messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager: IDP assertion spike detected on auth-gateway. Elevated SAML assertion errors and increased 5xxs. Suspected replay from external IP range 203.0.113.0/24. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.example/alerts/IDP-721
maya: Got it. Who's oncall?
devon: @oncall-sre i'm oncall, joining. Where's the bridge?
oncall-sre: I'm oncall — creating bridge now. ops-bridger, can you stand up a quick WAF block for that prefix?
ops-bridger: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/abc123. Applied temporary WAF block for 203.0.113.0/24 (in rate-limit mode first). :lock:
maya: Thx. Quick question — customer-facing SSO only or internal services too?
devon: Initial tail shows SAML responses from idp-prod failing with InvalidAudience and AssertionExpired. Requests originate from that IP block, same UA string repeating. Investigating headers for XFF.
elaine: Security: prepare to rotate svc-auth-broker keys and revoke sessions if scope confirmed. I'll hold until we have list.
security-pager: Agreed. Treat as potential replay. Immediate triage plan: block IP (ops done), collect affected session ids, revoke tokens, check for leaked logs.
security-pager: Quick query to gather context:
```
kubectl -n auth logs deploy/auth-gateway --since=20m | grep -i "SAML Assertion" | tail -n 200
```
devon: Output: repeated "InvalidAudience" and "Assertion expired" from same src IPs. Not seeing new config deploys. Noted a few requests with X-Forwarded-For that doesn't match remote_addr.
maya: Could be a misconfigured proxy rewriting XFF. Ops — any recent changes to proxies or logforwarders?
ops-bridger: No proxy or HAProxy changes in last 48h. Checked log-drains — none added. Noticed staging S3 sink accidentally had public ACL for ~12m yesterday (flagging, not yet related).
security-pager: Treat as credential replay for now. Steps: 1) keep block, 2) rotate service account keys for auth-broker, 3) revoke active SSO sessions from affected window, 4) verify no logs were exfiltrated, 5) customer impact check.
devon: Running revoke script now — will post commands.
devon: Commands used:
```
python tools/revoke_sessions.py --ids-file sessions-1865432109.txt --dry-run=false
```
devon: Revoke completed — ~420 sessions invalidated. Monitoring for errors. Post-block 5xxs back to baseline.
incident-bot: Update: alert severity decreased, 5xx rate back to baseline in last 10m.
ops-bridger: Starting controlled key rotation for svc-auth-broker. New KMS key created, deploying rotated secret in auth namespace.
maya: Collected logs and uploaded to secure bucket: s3://sec-incident-exports/1865432109.zip (access restricted to security team).
security-pager: Recommendation: rotate service keys and session tokens only. No evidence of SAML cert compromise — hold off rotating certs unless we find direct sign of private key exposure.
elaine: Opening forensic ticket and capturing PCAPs for 48h. Also pulling access logs from external sinks.
maya: Customer-impact assessment: no confirmed data exfiltration, sessions invalidated. @customer-success please pull customers with active SAML SSO during 2026-03-10T14:00 - 14:20Z window for outreach readiness.
customer-success: Got it — pulling list now and will prepare a heads-up template.
devon: Follow-ups: audit proxy XFF handling, add IDS/alert rule for repeated AssertionExpired/InvalidAudience patterns, schedule postmortem to review why session revocation threshold wasn't tripped earlier.
ops-bridger: I'll add an automated temporary ban rule: ban IPs with >100 assertion errors in 5m, and flag on-call if ban hits >10 distinct IPs in 1h.
security-pager: If any logs show external log drains or unexpected S3 writes during the window, escalate immediately.
incident-bot: Incident triaged and assigned: INC-2026-042. Owners: devon, elaine. Follow-up due 2026-03-12T09:00Z.
maya: Closing bridge in 30m if no regressions. Nice work team. :thumbsup:
